title: Wikipedia Monument
note: Four bronze figures lift a hollow jigsaw globe above layered stacks of pages. The plinth has the green plaque, and the globe includes cutouts at the crown, carved seams and characters from several scripts. The point placement follows the host terrain at the named artwork node. The plinth extends 4.8 cm below local Y=0 to sit across the sampled grade. Nearby roads, buildings, paths and landcover remain native.
